scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.restore:drill:local: npm run build --prefix backend && node backend/dist/tools/localRestoreDrill.js
scripts.security:audit: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix backend --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix frontend --audit-level=high
